Then, Ishigami give the beckoning cat that he bought but Kanemaru refused because the left hand is raised, then Ishigami became angry and get the beckoning cat and then hit it on Kanemaru Again. resolution.zhHans: 麻醉小五郎之后，他指出犯人是 Tamotsu Ishigami。起初，Tamotsu 约在下午 1 点，但他太忙，去不成。但小五郎让柯南交出一样东西，那是一个带血的爪印——它的前爪受了伤，而社长办公室窗上的爪印应该与手帕上的那个相同。Ishigami 说自己没来过。可是 Cha-Cha 来过——但一只小猫开门进来实在难以想象。窗户是开着的，但有防盗格栅，所以就算是猫也不可能从外面跳进来。这只剩下一种可能：Cha-Cha 是跟 Ishigami 一起来的。Tamotsu 按便条所约，下午 1 点来到这里与健三见面。接着，柯南告诉警方沙发底下有东西，那是一块招财猫的碎片——是 Ishigami 砸金丸那件凶器上的一块碎片。换句话说，那块碎片来自另一只不属于这套收藏的招财猫。他还说明：Ishigami 买了一只举左手的招财猫，在 1 点约会之前稍早来到这里，那时他看见了千佳。被千佳砸中的金丸只是失去意识，很快又醒了过来。接着，Ishigami 把自己买的招财猫递给他，但金丸拒收，因为那只猫举的是左手；Ishigami 于是发怒，夺回招财猫，又用它砸了金丸一下。Cha-Cha 被这情形惊吓，伤了爪子，惊惧之下从窗户逃了出去。与此同时，他决定把罪名栽给千佳，把金丸的尸体拖到主厅。随后他四处查看有无血迹溅落，把它们清理干净，收起大块碎片，再用吸尘器吸走小块碎片。接着，他连同集尘袋一起把它们带走了。不幸的是，他还是留下了几条证据。Tamotsu 供认，并揭示健三正打算把他的店收走。但由于他今天还不上钱，金丸就要把他的店收走。
resolution.en: After tranquilizing Kogoro, he reveals the culprit is Tamotsu Ishigami. First, Tamotsu was scheduled at 1:00 PM, but he can't go because he was very busy. But Kogoro told Conan to give something and it was a bloody pawprint, whose front paw was injured and the pawprint on the window of the president's office should be the same as the one on the handkerchief. Ishigami said that he hadn't come over. However, Cha-Cha did but it's unimaginable that a kitten opened the door and came in. The window was open, but there's a crime-prevention lattice, so even a cat couldn't jump in from outside. Which leave them one with one possibility: Cha-Cha came here with Ishigami. Tamotsu came here at 1:00 PM as promised on the memo and met with Kenzo. Then, Conan tells the police that there is something under the sofa, it was a beckoning cat fragment, that it was a fragment of the weapon Ishigami struck Kanemaru with. In other words, that fragment came from another beckoning cat that didn't belong to this collection. And tells that, Ishigami bought a beckoning cat with its left paw raised, and came here a little before the 1:00 PM appointment and that was when he saw Chika. Kanemaru, who had been struck by Chika only lost consciousness, and woke up soon after. Then, Ishigami give the beckoning cat that he bought but Kanemaru refused because the left hand is raised, then Ishigami became angry and get the beckoning cat and then hit it on Kanemaru Again. Startled at the situation, Cha-Cha injured her paw and frightened, escaped out the window. Meanwhile, he decided to frame Chika for the crime and dragged Kanemaru's body out into the main room. He then looked around for any blood splatters and cleaned them up, collected the large fragments, and used the vacuum cleaner to collect the small ones. Then, along with the dust bag, he took them away. Unfortunately for him, a few pieces of evidence were left behind. Tamotsu confesses and reveals Kenzo was trying to take his shop away from him. But, since he wasn't able to repay the money today he was going to take his shop away from him.

summary.en: Conan and Haibara rescue a kitten from a tree and return him to his owner, Tamotsu Ishigami, the owner of a local café. A woman barges into the café exclaiming she found her boss, Kenzo Kanemaru, dead.

suspects: Tamotsu Ishigami, Fumie Imaoka, and Chika Murai
